classification.difficultyReason: 1G Q31: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The negative discriminant invokes the real-square restriction demonstrated when rejecting a negative squared value on page 37.

answer.worked:
$x\ne0$. Multiply by $10x$.
$$\begin{align*}10x^2+10&=9x\\10x^2-9x+10&=0\\b^2-4ac&=(-9)^2-4(10)(10)\\b^2-4ac&=-319.\end{align*}$$
The quadratic formula requires the square root of a negative number, so there are no real solutions.
